description: This test ensures that clicking on a product title navigates to the product details page, where detailed information is displayed.
steps: Find the product titled 'ATID Yellow Shoes'.
Verify that the page navigates to 'https://atid.store/product/atid-yellow-shoes/'.
Verify that the product details page displays the product's name, price, and description.
expected_results: Clicking on 'ATID Yellow Shoes' navigates to 'https://atid.store/product/atid-yellow-shoes/'.
The product details page displays the correct product information.
edge_cases: Verify redirection behavior if the product page no longer exists.
Check for broken links or 404 errors.
Test with a slow network connection to ensure the page loads correctly.
Test the behavior when multiple product links are clicked simultaneously.
Ensure the product page is accessible for screen readers.
data_requirements: 'ATID Yellow Shoes' must be listed on the homepage.
The corresponding product details page must exist.
The product details page must include the product name, price, and description.
The product link must be enabled and functional.
The product details page must be populated with accurate data.
dependencies: The product must be listed under the homepage's product grid.
The product details page must be accessible.
The website must be online and functional.
api_interactions: Monitor any API calls fetching product data on the details page.
performance_metrics: Measure the time taken to load the product details page.
Check the responsiveness of the product link.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure that the product link is navigable using keyboard shortcuts.
Verify that the product link has appropriate ARIA labels.
Check the product details page for color contrast and screen reader compatibility.
